description: Header file defining parallel execution utilities for ATen library, including thread management, parallel for and reduce functions, and related classes and macros.

classes.name: ThreadIdGuard
classes.description: RAII class for temporarily setting thread ID within a scope.

methods.name: divup
methods.description: Performs integer division with ceiling, i.e., (x + y - 1) / y.

methods.name: lazy_init_num_threads
methods.description: Lazily initializes the number of threads at first parallel call.

methods.name: parallel_for
methods.description: Executes a user function in parallel over a range with specified grain size.

methods.name: parallel_reduce
methods.description: Performs parallel reduction over a range with specified grain size, using user-defined combine and reduce functions.
